shots.name: lens-correction-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Lens Correction card: the Preset menu showing Action Cam, the Lens menu on Manual, the Geometry section with Framing on Original size, Distortion −28, Fine Distortion 0, Scale 120 and Center X and Y 0.5, the folded Chromatic aberration section and the Vignette section with its switch, Amount and Midpoint, beside a strip of the preview with the straightened night street
shots.caption: Lens Correction with the Action Cam preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Lens: a measured lens or Manual. 3 — Framing: keep the size or show the whole photo. 4 — Distortion: straightens bowed lines. 5 — Scale: zooms in or out.

shots.name: guided-perspective-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Guided Perspective card: the Preset menu showing Fill Frame, the Perspective section with the Guides row and its Edit guides and Reset buttons, a note that two vertical guides are applied, the Framing menu on Fill frame, Strength 100 % and Scale 100 %, beside a strip of the preview with the straightened night street
shots.caption: Guided Perspective with two guides and the Fill Frame preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Guides: draw the lines in the Preview. 3 — Framing: whole photo or fill the frame. 4 — Strength: how much of the lean is removed. 5 — Scale: zooms in or out.

shots.name: ai-edge-fill-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with an AI Edge Fill card: the Generate section with Resolution on 2K, the Prompt field with the request to continue a room, the Generate fill button and a note that Nano Banana Pro on Kie.ai receives the corrected photo and a mask of its empty edges, then the Blend section with Fill Opacity 100 % and Seam Blend 12 px
shots.caption: AI Edge Fill before its first fill. 1 — Resolution: the size of the generated picture. 2 — Prompt: what the empty edges should show. 3 — Fill: sends the request. 4 — Fill Opacity: how strongly the fill shows. 5 — Seam Blend: matches its colour to the photo.

shots.name: twirl-inspector
shots.alt: The Twirl effect card in Properties → Effects: Twist 200°, Radius 0.6, Center X and Center Y 0.5, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror

shots.name: fisheye-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Fisheye Lens card on the Crystal Ball preset: the Lens section with Projection Stereographic, Strength 1, Field of View 160° and Curve Bias 0, the Framing section with Lens Radius 0.9, Zoom, Center X and Y, Squeeze, Lens Rotation and Round Lens, and the Edges section below, beside a strip of the preview with the walker inside a round glass ball
shots.caption: Fisheye Lens with the Crystal Ball preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Projection: the lens model. 3 — Strength: how far it bends. 4 — Field of View: how wide the lens sees. 5 — Lens Radius: the size of the lens circle.
